function.name: statistics_calculate_p_value
function.description: Calculate the p-value for a t-test on a single sample from a population. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

sample_mean.description: The mean of the sample data. This is a float type value.

population_mean.description: The mean of the population data. This is a float type value.

sample_std_dev.description: The standard deviation of the sample data. This is a float type value.

sample_size.description: The size of the sample data.

two_tailed.description: Whether the test is two-tailed. If not provided, default is true.

message.reasoning: The user says: "計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。" They want to calculate something about hypothesis testing? They mention sample mean 98.2, sample std dev 1.4, sample size 40, null hypothesis mean 98.6. They ask to compute the standard deviation? Actually they say "零假設檢定的標準差" which might mean "standard deviation of the test statistic"? Or maybe they want the standard error? Let's parse: "計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。" They want to compute the standard deviation of the test statistic under null hypothesis? That would be the standard error of the mean: sigma / sqrt(n). But we have sample standard deviation, not population. For t-test, we use sample standard deviation as estimate of population standard deviation. So standard error = s / sqrt(n) = 1.4 / sqrt(40). Compute sqrt(40) ~ 6.3249. So 1.4 / 6.3249 ≈ 0.2213. So standard error ~0.221. Then t-statistic = (sample_mean - population_mean) / SE = (98.2 - 98.6)/0.2213 = (-0.4)/0.2213 ≈ -1.807. So t ≈ -1.81. Then degrees of freedom df = n-1 = 39. Two-tailed p-value? We can compute using t distribution. For df=39, t=1.807. Let's approximate p-value. Use t distribution table: For df=40, t=1.684 gives p=0.10 (two-tailed). t=1.860 gives p=0.07. So t=1.807 gives p ~0.08. So p-value ~0.08. But the question: "計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。" They might want to compute the standard deviation of the sampling distribution of the mean (standard error). So answer: 0.221. Or they might want to compute the p-value. The phrase "零假設檢定的標準差" could be "standard deviation of the test statistic" which is the standard error. So I'd provide the standard error and maybe the t-statistic and p-value. Use the function to compute p-value. Let's call the function with sample_mean=98.2, population_mean=98.6, sample_std_dev=1.4, sample_size=40, two_tailed=true.
